question: Which contemporary chronicler acknowledged that Raziyya Sultan was more capable than her brothers?
solution: The correct answer is __**Minhaj-us-Siraj**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Minhaj-us-Siraj**, a Persian historian and chronicler of the 13th century, documented the history of the Delhi Sultanate in his famous work, the **"Tabaqat-i-Nasiri."** • In his writings, he acknowledged that **Raziyya Sultan** was more competent and capable than her brothers in handling the affairs of the state. • Raziyya Sultan, the first and only female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate, was chosen by her father, **Iltutmish**, as his successor due to her administrative skills and leadership qualities. • Minhaj-us-Siraj praised her for her intelligence, bravery, and ability to manage state affairs, which made her stand out among her contemporaries. • This acknowledgment is significant as it highlights the progressive mindset of Iltutmish and the exceptional abilities of Raziyya Sultan during a time when women were rarely seen in leadership roles.
